scope: The standing Bogor Palace in West Java, comprising the central white palace and its two connected wing ranges and porticos.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The National Library of Indonesia’s presidential collection records the present palace and describes its continuity with the mid-nineteenth-century reconstruction.
The national cultural encyclopedia identifies completion of the post-earthquake reconstruction during the 1856–1861 administration.
The State Secretariat identifies the standing palace in Bogor as an active presidential palace.
